task_goal: Land on the pad at (0,0) with legs in contact, minimizing time and fuel use.
state_space: 8-dim: normalized x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular velocity, left leg contact, right leg contact.
action_space: Discrete: 0=do nothing, 1=fire left orientation engine, 2=fire main engine, 3=fire right orientation engine.
termination_modes: High speed or angle at ground contact.
success_like_ending: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Position near (0,0) (state[0] and state[1] close to 0).
Low linear and angular velocities at landing.
Episode termination due to landing (not crash/out-of-bounds).
failure_like_endings: High speed or angle at ground contact.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad using main engine and orientation control.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity near pad.
Phase 3: Soft landing with both legs contacting pad, minimal residual velocity.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing far from pad (still gets leg contact but misses primary objective).
Excessive fuel use due to inefficient engine firing patterns.
Over-reliance on orientation engines causing oscillation.
